ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with a contrast ratio of approximately 92% dark to 8% light pixels including white markings and specular reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation covering >90% of the visible area; high-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and scattered stochastically as small punctate dots across the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe intersection point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency micro-serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; distal tips show macro-level jagged irregularities and non-uniform pixel peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature of the trailing edge boundary originating from the median notch and extending to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular high-contrast white spots distributed across the dark field of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of four parallel high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) on the lower quadrant of the right lobe; scattered unaligned white linear disruptions visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at both distal tips; distinct jagged indentation/trauma on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Two prominent vertical high-contrast white scars located near the ventral-basal region of the left lobe.
